summary: Recorded the snapshot-stream receiver's ordering rule from the transport path: an unknown key only becomes tracked when it is the first chunk and a slot is free, a chunk whose id is not the next expected id is logged and ignored without advancing the expectation, a chunk from a different sender than the tracked first chunk is ignored, and only the last chunk triggers validation, finalisation and delivery, with save failures removing the temp directory and terminating. Added the two source anchors. No defect claim and no execution this turn.
